text:
Eden: Heads-up: Big customer wants a contractual "burst allowance" on top of their reserved commit. They want clear SLA language, billing behavior for overage, and an autoscale handshake so we can pre-authorize short bursts. Need spec + launch gating.

Cal: Quick sketch of the feature: per-tenant contract fields: burst_allowance_tokens_per_min, burst_duration_mins, burst_price_schema (hosted/discounted), and a preauth_window (minutes before expected burst when we can pre-warm). Routing side will check envelope and allow a temporary headroom token bucket.

Rosa: Ops constraints: we need circuit-breaker safety. Proposal: only honor burst if pool_util < 92% at decision time OR if fallback models are configured. Also add an emergency-revoke endpoint so SRE can strip burst privileges if capacity tight.

Ben: Billing needs: explicit ledger events for burst_granted, burst_used, burst_revoked. If billing at discounted rate, finance needs a reconciliation delta exported daily. We'll add a field billed_rate_type on events. Also require a customer opt-in flag in contract.

Ana: Sales note: customers will insist on deterministic notices when bursts are consumed. We need console messaging + optional webhook. Also legal will want standard rubric for when we deny bursts due to capacity.

Cal: Implementation notes: control-plane API additions + routing token-bucket. API example:
POST /v1/pools/<pool>/burst_policy {"burst_allowance":10000, "duration_mins":15, "price":"hosted"}
Routing logic pseudo: allocate temporary bucket per-tenant with refill = burst_allowance/duration. Enforced at edge.

Rosa: PromQL I'd use to guard rollout:
sum(rate(dedicated_pool_tokens_total{pool_id=~".+"}[1m])) by (pool_id) < (pool_capacity_tokens_per_min * 0.92)
Also alert if burst_revoked_count spikes: sum(rate(burst_revoked_total[5m])) by (pool_id) > 1

Eden: Contract language draft idea: "Customer may request a Burst Allowance defined as X tokens/min for Y minutes. Burst usage will be billed according to agreed price_schema. Redwood reserves the right to revoke burst allowance when cluster capacity, safety, or SLAs are at risk; customers will be notified within Z minutes and routed to fallback models per configuration." Thoughts?

Ben: Add a line about reconciliation: "Daily reconciliation events will show observed vs billed tokens; disputes must be raised within 30 days." Also require a billing flag in control plane so we can honor enterprise discounts.

Ana: I'll loop in legal to firm up verbiage. Also will ask customer to provide expected burst windows (tz-aware) to help scheduling.

Cal: Telemetry required before pilot: burst_active{tenant,pool}, burst_tokens_used, burst_revoked{tenant,pool,reason}, and cost_delta_by_day. Dashboards + 30d raw retention.

Rosa: Runbook edits: add 'revoke burst' snippet:
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  https://control-plane/api/tenants/<id>/burst/revoke -d '{"reason":"capacity_pressure"}'
Add an emergency play: pause bursts globally if overall spare capacity < 5% for 10m.

Eden: Gating checklist for pilot (customer-provided envelope):
- API + control-plane web UI to create burst_policy
- telemetry and dashboards live
- billing events exported to BQ with billed_rate_type
- runbook + revoke endpoint tested in dry-run
- notification path (console + webhook) working
- 48h canary with synthetic long-context traffic and customer traffic
Owners: Cal (API & telemetry), Rosa (runbook & alerts), Ben (billing exports), Ana (customer coordination).

Cal: Dev ETA: API + routing prototype in 7 working days behind feature flag. Will include a feature-flag matrix for pilot.

Ben: I'll add the ledger schema and a sample reconciliation query:
SELECT tenant_id, pool_id, SUM(billed_tokens) AS billed, SUM(observed_tokens) AS observed FROM `billing.events` WHERE DATE(timestamp) = DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY tenant_id, pool_id

Rosa: Add SLO note: bursts should not degrade reserved-tenant p95 beyond allowed margin. If p95 for reserved tenants > SLA + 25% for 5m, auto-revoke bursts. PromQL:
sum(rate(dedicated_pool_p95_latency_ms[5m])) by (pool_id) > (sla_p95_ms * 1.25)

Eden: Risk log: token attribution gaps, billing disputes from delayed exports, customer surprise if revoked without adequate notice. Mitigations: require tenant_id on all tokens, daily reconciliation + webhook, and a two-stage revoke (soft warn -> revoke).

Ana: I'll draft customer communications for soft-warn + revoke. Also will ask customers if they want pre-paid burst credits vs pay-as-you-go. Capture preference in contract.

Cal: Feature-flag toggled for pilot pool by ops-bot: ops-bot: feature "burst_allowance" enabled for pool=pilot-redwood at 1922223388

Rosa: We'll run a dry-run revoke at 1922223400 to validate runbook steps. Please don't use real traffic during 10:00-10:15 PST.

Eden: OK. Next sync Thursday 9am to review telemetry from the dry-run and decide go/no-go for the customer pilot. Ping in-thread if blockers show up.
